agent_evaluation.summary: Referee reconciliation: doorstep Kembangan MRT and below-median PSF are real, but building-level defects found in the sibling 2BR evaluation (failing roof waterproofing, water ingress, special-levy risk) apply to every unit type and cap the rating.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Downgraded from Buy: 130m EWL MRT + 7% PSF discount remain, but documented waterproofing failures and dereliction reported in 2BR research are building-wide; add 1995-vintage lease decay and the value case needs a deep defect/levy check before any Buy.
